item.title: DiCarlo to raise Pakistan airstrikes on Afghanistan with UN member states
item.description: United Nations Under-Secretary-General for Political and Peacebuilding Affairs Rosemary DiCarlo has expressed sorrow over civilian casualties caused by Pakistani military airstrikes in Afghanistan and said the matter would be raised with UN member states and other stakeholders.

item.title: Pezeshkian gives go-ahead to plan for free trade zone between Iran, Afghanistan, China
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has approved a plan to establish a free trade zone linking Iran, Afghanistan and China, reports IRNA.

item.title: 16 killed in bus-truck collision in Yemen
item.description: At least 16 people, including eight women and children, have been killed in a collision between a bus and a truck in Yemen, media reports said on Wednesday.

item.title: 23 dead as heavy rains unleash floods in Brazil
item.description: At least 23 people have died after torrential rainfall triggered severe flooding in the Brazilian state of Minas Gerais.

item.title: 2D Seismic survey begins in 3 Afghan-Tajik oil basin blocks
item.description: The Ministry of Mines and Petroleum (MoMP) has announced that, under an agreement with the geological company Uzbekgeofizika JSC, 2D seismic survey operations have commenced for the Mohammad Jan field, Ahmadabad, and Shumar blocks in the Afghan–Tajik oil basin.

item.title: Mothers call for expansion of malnutrition treatment services
item.description: Some mothers of children suffering from malnutrition have welcomed the services currently available at health centres in this area, but are calling for their expansion.

item.title: 62 tribal, family disputes resolved in Jawzjan this year
item.description: About 62 cases of tribal and family disputes have been resolved through mediation and tribal jirgas in northern Jawzjan province during the current solar year, the Department of Borders and Tribal Affairs reported.

item.title: Pakistan orders closure of Afghan refugee camp in Sawabi
item.description: Pakistani authorities have closed all shops in the Afghan refugee camp Gohati in Sawabi district, notifying Afghan nationals that the camp has officially been terminated.
